open_questions: Upstream stop names come from Travel Culture and HamariWeb; several are ambiguous (Chandni Chowk, Nursery, Jinnah University sit far from the OSM stop of the same name).
Coordinates were picked in Google Maps by the authors; the CC-BY licence covers the dataset, but check whether Google's terms restrict redistribution of the picked points.
Route directions are single-direction only and the collection date (pre Oct-2024) predates the 2025-2026 Peoples Bus/EV expansions.
